北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有霾，体感 1℃。出门记得戴口罩、多穿衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is hazy, feels like 1°C. Remember masks and warm clothes!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云，体感 3℃。风有点凉，记得添衣保暖。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 3°C. It's chilly, so dress warmly!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴朗，体感 4℃。风小但依旧凉，注意保暖别着凉。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny, feels like 4°C. Gentle breeze, but still cool, stay warm!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，体感 23℃。天气舒适，注意补水，享受好时光。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, feels like 23°C. Pleasant weather, stay hydrated and enjoy!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 17℃。早晚凉意浓，记得加件外套。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 17°C. Mornings/evenings are cool, bring a jacket.
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感 6℃。虽是多云，别忘了多穿点防寒。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels like 6°C. Even with clouds, remember to dress warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 4℃。阴冷，出门记得多穿衣别感冒。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast, feels like 4°C. It's chilly, dress warmly to avoid a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 11℃，湿度 100%。湿冷，注意防潮保暖哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, feels like 11°C with 100% humidity. It's damp and chilly, stay warm!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 8℃，风力 3级。风大，注意防风保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast, feels like 8°C with strong winds. Keep warm from the wind.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 2℃。有点冷，多穿几件衣服防寒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, feels like 2°C. It's quite cold, layer up to keep warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 11℃。湿度较高，出门带伞，注意保暖。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feels like 11°C with high humidity. Bring an umbrella and stay warm.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴，体感 -12℃。天寒地冻，全副武装出门哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny, feels like -12°C. It's freezing, bundle up completely!
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 -5℃。虽然有阳光，记得多穿保暖哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels like -5°C. Sunny but cold, remember to dress warmly.
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 17℃。天气宜人，早晚温差大，带件薄外套。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast, feels like 17°C. Pleasant, but mind the temp change, bring a light jacket.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 9℃。风力 3级，风凉，记得添衣保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 9°C with winds. It's chilly, so dress warmly!
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感 -1℃。阳光虽好，但依旧寒冷，注意防寒。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny, feels like -1°C. Despite sun, it's cold, stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感 -3℃。寒风凛冽，记得戴帽子围巾保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels like -3°C. It's biting cold, remember your hat and scarf!
